source_text: Iubetur Moyses virga percutere mare ut via sicca populo fiat. Baptismi figura: hostes merguntur, populus transit. Christus aperit iter per aquam. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Is-commanded Moses with-rod to-strike sea that way dry for-people may-become. Of-baptism figure: enemies are-sunk, people crosses. Christ opens way through water. Amen.
pass_b_english: Moses is commanded to [[strike the sea with his rod >> Bible:Exodus 14:16]] so a dry path opens. It figures baptism: enemies sink, the people pass through [[baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea >> Bible:1 Corinthians 10:1-2]]. Christ opens the way through water. Amen.
